final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record. That reframing is partly valid: the evidence does support a narrower reading than unconditional compliance, and it correctly concedes that stale approval and informal monitoring are insufficient. But the unresolved issue is not merely whether caveats would make certification conceptually defensible; the policy requires evidence that the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and that material weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The admissible record still does not show that this predicate has been met. That is the distinction: a clearly caveated position can justify compliant_with_caveats only when the caveat is already embodied in the required current-release documentation or backed by approved mitigation. Here, the caveat remains a missing compliance condition rather than an evidenced satisfied condition. Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support overall launch readiness, but they do not cure the documentary and governance gap for the current refund-workflow regression. On the available evidence, the claim remains plausible but unsupported at the level required for compliance.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the current release documentation actually reflects the current evaluation results.
No admissible evidence shows the required disclosure of the refund-workflow limitation is already present in the current certification record or model card.
No admissible evidence shows approved mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or formal owner acceptance for the current refund-workflow regression.
The enterprise refund workflow remains a current material weakness in a named launch use case.
Prior approval predates the current prompt-template change and eval batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release policy predicate.
Informal monitoring comments are contextual only and do not substitute for reviewed mitigation or current documentary compliance.
